name: ManyChat
free_plan_limits: 25 active contacts a month, 4 live automations
usage_note: $0.05 per extra active contact on Pro
notes: Pro: $39 monthly or $29 yearly, 2,500 active contacts, 14-day trial. Essential $14/mo is yearly billing. Pricing is for accounts made after March 2, 2026; older accounts differ.

name: Copilot Studio
usage_note: Pay as you go: $0.01 per Copilot Credit
since_note: Renamed from Power Virtual Agents (2019) in November 2023 (Microsoft announcement).
notes: $200 a month per 25,000 credits; one guide says billed yearly, a later one drops that. Pay-as-you-go has no fee, just $0.01 a credit. Unused credits don't roll over.

name: Voiceflow
best_for: Teams designing complex chat and voice agents
notes: Current prices not stated. Docs describe a free plan, Pro and Business with usage credits and paid extra editor seats. An older post said Pro $60/mo, seats $50 each; may be outdated.

name: Botpress
best_for: Custom AI agents with some coding
notes: Conflicting: newest Botpress blog posts say Plus $150/mo and Team $750/mo; one says $89 and $495. Pricing page not confirmed. AI usage is said to be bundled.

name: Fastbots
best_for: Simple website chatbots trained on your pages
notes: Essential: 2 bots, 2,000 messages. Business $89, Premium $199. One page says the free tier is a 14-day trial instead. Prices from Fastbots' own blog, not the live pricing page.

name: Zapier Chatbots
since_note: Launched as a beta March 2024 (Zapier press release).
best_for: Simple bots wired into Zapier automations
notes: Pro add-on $160 a year (5 bots, website embed); Zapier blog said $20/mo instead, so price is uncertain. Both pages are about a year old. Separate from Zapier task plans.

name: Dialogflow
free_plan_limits: ES Trial Edition with limited quota; CX has a $600 trial credit
usage_note: ES: $0.002 per text request; CX: $0.007 per text request
since_note: Released as api.ai in September 2014; renamed Dialogflow 2017 (Wikipedia).
best_for: Developers building bots on Google Cloud
notes: Pay per request, no monthly fee. CX audio is $0.06/min. Channel connections (Instagram, WhatsApp) not confirmed. Trial credit sources conflict.

name: Chatbase
best_for: AI support bot trained on your docs
notes: Hobby: 700 credits, 2 members ($32 yearly). Standard $150, Pro $500. Helpdesk and voice start at Standard. Prices from Chatbase's own blog; pricing page not read.
